attacks.name: Spring Back

attacks.name: Spiral Growth

attacks.name: All-out Blast

attacks.name: Whirlpool
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Leaf Shade
attacks.text: Count the amount of Energy attached to Celebi Star. Put that many damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Critical Collection
attacks.text: Count the number of Prize cards your opponent has taken. Search your discard pile for up to that many Water Energy cards and attach them to Kyogre Star.

attacks.name: Sheer Cold

attacks.name: Energy Absorption

attacks.name: Psychic Star
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is an Evolved Pokémon, discard all Energy attached to Mewtwo Star and this attack does 50 damage plus 50 more damage.

attacks.name: Ice Barrier
attacks.text: Prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Regice Star by your opponent's Pokémon-ex during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Final Blizzard
attacks.text: If your opponent has only 1 Prize card left and Regice Star is the only Pokémon you have in play, this attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Lightning Turn

attacks.name: Meta Voltage
attacks.text: If you have less Prize cards left than your opponent, this attack does 40 damage to each of your Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Erasure Ball
attacks.text: You may discard up to 2 Energy from your Benched Pokémon. This attack does 60 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Genome Hacking
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

attacks.name: Brave Wing
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack does 100 more damage.

attacks.name: Explosive Vortex
attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.text: Heal 50 damage from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Draconic Buster
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Burning Darkness
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken.

attacks.name: Shinobi Blade
attacks.text: You may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Mirage Barrage
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 120 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Flame Screen
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 50 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Evil Incineration
attacks.text: Discard a Team Rocket's Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, discard your opponent's Active Pokémon and all attached cards.

attacks.name: Tainted Horn
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During Pokémon Checkup, put 8 damage counters on that Pokémon instead of 1.

attacks.name: Voltage Burst
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken. This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Blazing Burst
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken. Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Eon Blade
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Hypno Splash
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Miracle Force
attacks.text: This Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.

attacks.name: Full Moon Rondo
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Assassin's Return
attacks.text: You may put this Pokémon into your hand. (Discard all cards attached to this Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Multishot Lightning
attacks.text: This attack also does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Dangerous Toxwhip
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Twin Cannons
attacks.text: Discard up to 2 Basic Water Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 140 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Wide Blast
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Expert Splasher
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

cards.name: Groudon

attacks.name: Swelling Power
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Fighting Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Magma Purge
attacks.text: Discard up to 4 Energy from your Pokémon. This attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

cards.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Ascension
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

cards.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Blazing Destruction
attacks.text: Discard a Stadium in play.

cards.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

cards.name: Squirtle

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.

cards.flavorText: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

cards.name: Tyranitar

attacks.name: Rout
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dread Mountain
attacks.text: Discard the top 4 cards of your deck.

cards.flavorText: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn't care about others.

cards.name: Bulbasaur

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

cards.name: Gastly

attacks.name: Mysterious Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

cards.name: Charmeleon

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

cards.name: Raichu

attacks.name: Electrocharge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Lightning Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

cards.name: Wartortle

attacks.name: Free Diving
attacks.text: Put up to 3 Basic Water Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.flavorText: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

cards.name: Ivysaur

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

cards.name: Drowzee

attacks.name: Forced Sleep

cards.flavorText: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

attacks.name: Gaia Volcano
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 100 more damage. Discard that Stadium card.

attacks.name: Magma Quake
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 80 more damage.

attacks.name: Sky Return
attacks.text: Return this Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

attacks.name: Rising Fist
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Chrono Wind
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Pokémon-EX, it can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Full Metal Impact

attacks.name: Evil Ball

attacks.name: Y Cyclone
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Gyarados

attacks.name: Full Retaliation
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each damage counter on each of your Benched Magikarp.

attacks.name: Thrash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage. If tails, this Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

attacks.name: Night Attack
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dark Corridor
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tidal Storm
attacks.text: Move 2 Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon-EX. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Replace
attacks.text: Move as many Energy attached to your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Buster Purge
attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Aero Unit-GX
attacks.text: Attach 5 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to it during your opponent's next turn. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Towering Splash-GX
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 7 extra Water Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 100 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Rolling Panic
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Supreme Puff-GX
attacks.text: Take another turn after this one. (Skip the between-turns step.) If this Pokémon has at least 14 extra Fairy Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), your opponent shuffles all of their Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to them into their deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Poltergeist
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. This attack does 50 damage for each Trainer card you find there.

attacks.name: Horror House-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any cards from their hand during their next turn. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Psychic Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), each player draws cards until they have 7 cards in their hand. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Tandem Shock
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was on the Bench and became your Active Pokémon this turn, this attack does 80 more damage, and your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Lightning Ride-GX
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra Lightning Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 100 more damage. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Fabled Flarebolts
attacks.text: Discard up to 3 in any combination of basic Fire and basic Lightning Energy cards from your Benched Pokémon. This attack does 90 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Cross Break-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 170 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. If you played N's Resolve from your hand during this turn, this attack also does 170 damage to 1 of your opponent's other Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Greedy Crush
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, take 1 more Prize card.

attacks.name: Gigafall-GX
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 5 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), discard the top 15 cards of your opponent's deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Fairy Song
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Fairy Energy cards and attach them to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Kaleidostorm
attacks.text: Move any number of Energy from your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Magical Miracle-GX
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra Fairy Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), your opponent shuffles their hand into their deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Linear Attack
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Calamitous Slash
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 80 more damage.

attacks.name: GG End-GX
attacks.text: Discard 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and all cards attached to it. If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra Fighting Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), discard 2 of your opponent's Pokémon instead. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Splash Maker
attacks.text: You may attach up to 3 Water Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like. If you do, heal 50 damage from those Pokémon for each card you attached to them in this way.

attacks.name: Bubble Launcher-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra Water Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 150 more damage. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Severe Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 8 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Poison Absorption
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, heal 100 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Nasty Goo Mix-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned. If this Pokémon has at least 4 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), put 15 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Cheer Up
attacks.text: Attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dump Truck Press
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 120 more damage.

attacks.name: Megaton Friends-GX
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), draw cards until you have 10 cards in your hand. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Raichu

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Raichu.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Raichu does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

cards.name: Nidoking

attacks.name: Thrash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage and Nidoking does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Toxic
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. It now takes 20 Poison damage instead of 10 after each player's turn (even if it was already Poisoned).

cards.flavorText: Uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break its prey's bones.

cards.name: Venusaur
cards.flavorText: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

cards.name: Blastoise

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Extra Water Energy after the 2nd doesn't count.

cards.flavorText: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.

cards.name: Alakazam

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.flavorText: While seeming to do nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

attacks.text: Choose 1 of your Benched Fusion Strike Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

attacks.name: Max Miracle
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fetch and Hide

attacks.text: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. If any of those cards are Energy cards, attach them to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Burst
attacks.text: Discard all basic Fire Energy or all basic Lightning Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 60 damage times the number of Energy cards you discarded.
